ui.reportChart.title: Capacity by home discipline
ui.reportChart.scope: Current home disciplines; all visible planning work of the selected people. Capacity already includes time away; Confirmed already includes approved reservations.
ui.reportChart.rule: Planning demand is Confirmed + Expected. Possible is shown separately and excluded. Weekly shortfall sums positive discipline shortages in each displayed week; spare weeks do not cancel shortages.
ui.reportChart.export: Export downloads the original measure matrix; the comparison is shown on this screen.
ui.reportChart.figure: Capacity, planning demand and weekly shortfall by home discipline
ui.reportChart.partial: Visible work only; planning coverage may be incomplete.
ui.reportChart.basis: {period}: {weeks} displayed ISO weeks; standard denominator {hours} h. Read {asOf}.
ui.reportChart.truncated: {returned} of {total} disciplines returned within the 2,000-row limit. Refine the report scope to see excluded disciplines.
ui.reportChart.recorded: Recorded source hours: {hours} h; coverage incomplete
ui.reportChart.complete: Complete for the visible report scope.
ui.reportChart.empty: No disciplines in the authorised comparison scope.
ui.reportChart.fallback: Chart unavailable. The comparison values remain in the table.
ui.reportChart.focusReset: Chart focus was reset to an available period and returned page.
